jobs.title: NPI Laboratory Technician
jobs.description:
Therm-x of California is the leading manufacturer for Advanced Temperature and Control Systems for Hi-Technology industries. We have been in business for over 30 years and have a diverse customer base. We offer **competitive pay,** and a comprehensive benefits package.

We are seeking a skilled NPI Laboratory Technician to join our Engineering team. This role is focused on new product introduction (NPI) prototype workflows, RF and electrical testing, and electro-mechanical assembly within a dedicated laboratory environment. Reporting directly to the Engineering Manager, the successful candidate will support product development and validation activities, ensuring all assemblies meet customer and industry specifications. The role requires strong technical laboratory skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently within an ISO 9001 semiconductor manufacturing environment.

**Essential responsibilities and duties;**

* Read and execute work orders — including schematics, wiring diagrams, parts lists, and assembly instructions — to build, repair, and/or test electrical, electro-mechanical, vacuum, and pneumatic assemblies, subassemblies, and components.
* Perform electro-mechanical assembly operations; troubleshoot and repair units as required.
* Manage the NPI prototype area to meet customer requirements for electrical, thermal, and mechanical performance; receive and audit incoming parts, inspect for defects, and drive continuous process improvements.
* Set up, operate, and maintain RF test equipment including vector network analyzers (VNA), spectrum analyzers, signal generators, power meters, and impedance analyzers to characterize RF assemblies and components.
* Perform RF measurements including S-parameters (S11, S21, etc.), insertion loss, return loss, VSWR, impedance matching, gain/phase response, and frequency response across specified test frequencies.
* Use electronic measurement equipment — including DMMs, oscilloscopes, waveform generators, LCR meters, and lock-in amplifiers — and test fixtures, leak detectors, and vacuum pumps to verify electrical performance and test assemblies; maintain calibration records for all equipment.
* Interpret RF test data, generate test reports, and disposition units as pass/fail against acceptance criteria; escalate anomalies to engineering.
* Support development and maintenance of RF test fixtures, jigs, and automated test setups; apply RF shielding, grounding, and cable management best practices to ensure measurement integrity.
* Operate and troubleshoot laboratory equipment including 3D printers, plastic engraving/cutting lasers, and precision measurement tools (calipers, scales, gauges).
* Collaborate closely with engineers on new product development and validation; support technology transfer activities including training laboratory staff on procedures and test methods.
* Maintain laboratory organization, inventory, and equipment calibration schedules; complete all required documentation including test results, nonconformance reports, and progress records in compliance with ISO 9001 requirements.
* Interpret and apply mechanical and electrical circuit drawings, RF schematic layouts, and assembly specifications; perform software installs and equipment firmware updates as needed.

**Desired Skills;**

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Strategic agility with strong critical and logical thinking; ability to analyze complex problems and perform functions with minimal guidance.
* Ability to prioritize, multi-task, and adapt in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
* Hands-on capability in a lab and prototype assembly setting.
* Experience coordinating and collaborating across teams to meet organizational goals.
* Experience working within an ISO 9001 quality environment.
* Ability to understand tolerances and compliance requirements within the semiconductor industry.
* Experience with precision measurement tools such as calipers and scales.
* Proficiency with electrical test equipment: DMM, oscilloscope, waveform generator, and related instruments.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience as a manufacturing technician, laboratory technician, or laboratory assistant in a semiconductor, electronics, or related technical manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated experience with RF test equipment (VNA, spectrum analyzer, signal generator, power meter) and RF measurement techniques.
* Proficiency with standard electronic test instruments: DMM, oscilloscope, and waveform generator.
* Experience working within an ISO 9001 quality environment.

**Physical Demands:** While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; talk or hear and taste or smell. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 30 pounds.

jobs.title: Research Assistant/Associate I
jobs.description:
Programmable Medicine, a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company located in Redwood City, is seeking

a Research Associate/Lab Manager for the Chemistry Department. Programmable Medicine is focused on developing novel nanomedicines, HD therapeutics (HDTs), to treat unmet medical needs in ophthalmology, neurology, inflammatory diseases, and neuro-oncology. Our HD platform builds therapeutics that are selectively taken up only by inflamed tissues, allowing us to treat diseases with unprecedented precision.

We are seeking an individual who is motivated to learn and has a basic understanding and familiarity with laboratory equipment and processes. The responsibilities of this position include performing standard chemical reactions and analysis, helping to purchase/maintain laboratory supplies/inventories, equipment maintenance , and ensuring compliance with laboratory safety and compliance.

To thrive in this role, a person should enjoy a small company environment where you will work on a variety of tasks, from playing a hands on role in the lab to maintaining inventories and managing laboratory supplies. Individuals who are ambitious and demonstrate a willingness to learn will have the opportunity to develop as a researcher and a contributor to our scientific efforts over time. This person should be proactive in finding ways to streamline laboratory function and enable the team to achieve higher productivity. A person who is driven by enhancing productivity through daily efforts to streamline processes will be highly appreciated!

**Duties and Responsibilities - Essential Functions**

* Perform basic chemical synthesis and analysis – Work with the chemistry team to learn our platform and contribute to a novel approach for developing therapeutics
* Instrument maintenance and development – work with vendors and technicians to install, enhance, maintain, and learn new techniques on current and future equipment
* Assist Scientists with compound management – Consolidate, standardize, dispense, track, store
* Coordinate the purchase of routine chemical and consumables in support of the laboratory operations, organize laboratory materials to ensure all staff are able to find what they need
* Work with our safety consultant to ensure laboratory compliance and proper waste management.
* Other tasks may include light management of chemistry group software licenses, organizing the stockroom, and other roles as needed.

**Job Requirements**

* Bachelor Degree in a related scientific discipline (preferable chemistry) with 0-2 years of relevant experience. New college graduates must have completed at least one internship playing a hands-on role in a laboratory or part-time work, during undergraduate degree, working in a laboratory setting.
* Demonstrated experience and a passion for organizing and maintaining a lab
* Solid presentation, writing, and communication skills along with problem solving and mathematical skills
* Forward-thinking and creative with high ethical standards and a strong work ethic
* Strategic thinker with good judgment and strong operational focus
* Well organized and self-directed
* Must be able to work on-site five full days per week at our Redwood City Laboratory 5 days per week

**What We Can Offer You**

This is a unique opportunity to join a team focused on the development of a new class of precision

medicines that selectively treat diseased cells in regions of inflammation. By making precision medicine

even more precise, our nanomedicine technology has the potential to change the standard of care across

ophthalmology, neurology, inflammatory diseases and neuro-oncology. You will have the opportunity to

learn new skills and gain a better understanding of the cutting-edge technology.

We have a comprehensive total compensation package including fully paid medical, dental and vision

benefits for you and your family. We want all of our employees to have the opportunity to become

shareholders and offer new hire stock options. The Company also offers participation in the annual bonus program. The base salary for this position is $65,000 – $80,000 per year. We consider various factors when determining the base compensation, including market survey data, experience, qualifications, and geographic location, which means that the actual compensation may vary.

jobs.title: Clinical Lab Assistant- Licensed Phlebotomist
jobs.description:
**HM Services of California, a Centurion company, is proud to provide healthcare staffing solutions to the California Department of State Hospitals.**

We are currently seeking a **full-time Clinical Laboratory Assistant** to join our team at **Napa State Hospital** located in **Napa, California. Must have California Phlebotomy license in good standing with a** **minimum 1 year experience drawing blood after CPT licensure**

**Monday - Friday Day shift 8am-4:30pm or 7am-3:30pm**

**$26.00 per hour + Medical, dental and vision benefits offered**

The Clinical Lab Assistant (CA Staffing) works under the general direction of the Supervising Clinical Laboratory Technologist to perform assigned, varied, standardized, and non-technical laboratory procedures.

Essential Duties:  

* Collecting specimen (drawing blood)
* Processing and preparing specimen for testing and shipping
* Assisting in laboratory clerical duties
* Cleaning and caring for laboratory equipment
* Preparing simple laboratory reagents
* Operating simple laboratory equipment
* Using the Laboratory Information System (LIS) to order tests, print reports, and data log
* Using the Physician Ordering System (POS) for scheduling blood draws and ordering tests
* Other duties as assigned

* High school diploma or GED equivalent required
* Willingness to participate in on-the-job training
* Ability to pass drug screen and criminal background check
